title: Two-Dimensional $β$-plane Turbulence: Dual Cascade and Zonal Jets
summary: We derive an exact and novel expression for an averaged two-point correlation function in the statistically stationary, forced-dissipative two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations subject to the Coriolis force under the beta-plane approximation. This identity is related to the so-called geostrophic balance: it connects the effect of the Coriolis force to the pressure gradient through a two-point correlation function.
